title: Hard: draggable parameter drives tick + linked chart.line
prompt: Create an interactive lab world: (1) a data-backed knob node the user can drag horizontally, writing __event.x back (use clamp); (2) a tick that appends to a numeric series using array concat `series = series + [...]` and safe math sin/cos; (3) a top-level chart.line bound to that series. Do not copy toy counter demos. Output ONLY Viva source starting with artifact.
